Question: 当采用分块查找时，数据的组织方式为____
Options:
A. 数据分成若干块， 每块内数据有序
B. 数据分成若干块， 每块内数据不必有序， 但块间必须有序， 每块内最大（ 或最小） 的数据组成索引块
C. 数据分成若干块， 每块内数据有序， 但块间必须有序， 每块内最大（ 或最小） 的数据组成索引块
D. 数据分成若干块， 每块（ 除最后一块外） 中数据个数需相同

Need know block search / index sequential search (分块查找) organization: data divided into blocks; within each block can be unordered (or ordered depending implementation), but blocks must be ordered: max key in previous block < min key in next block (or all elements in block <= all in next), index table stores max key and start position of each block. For efficiency, can have within block ordered, but basic requirement is blocks ordered, within block unordered acceptable. Standard textbook: 分块查找：将线性表分成若干块，每块中的记录无序，但块间有序，即第i块中所有记录的关键字均小于第i+1块中所有记录的关键字。建立索引表，包含每个子表中最大关键字和起始位置。 So answer B. Need final line format 答案：B.

Need be careful: Some definitions say each block may be ordered (if use sequential/binary within block) but necessary condition is block interval ordered. Option B exactly. C says block inside ordered and between ordered. It is a possible but not necessary, question asks data organization way for block search? Standard: 每块内数据不必有序，块间有序，索引块. So B.
